ModifyReplicationZone.isDefer: Whether to execute during the maintenance window. `true`: execute during the maintenance window; `false`: execute immediately
ModifyReplicationZone.replicationInfo: Replica information. Full replica information is required; the availability zone and subnet can be modified.
ModifyReplicationZone.replicationInfo.isMaster: Whether it is the master node. There is one and only one master node. `1`: master node; `0`: slave node
